sections.summary: The prospect is interested in testing the product using a real call recording to determine if it can overcome their lack of trust in AI summaries. The prospect must first verify if they are permitted to share the recording. Marcus will send a recording from last week by Thursday, and the Rep will provide notes based on that recording the same day it is received.
sections.followUpEmail:
We discussed how a lack of trust in AI summaries is currently a blocker. To address this, we agreed to test the product using a real call recording rather than a demo to see if it can effectively handle complex conversations.

Agreed actions:
- You will verify if you are permitted to share a recording and send one by Thursday.
- I will provide notes based on that recording on the same day I receive it.
